scientific_integrity: All-base identities are proved by explicit cases and finite polynomial sums; a separate exact verifier checks selected finite bases. Finite verification alone does not establish the theorem.
scientific_limitations: The counts measure first entrance into the invariant odd region, not actual terminal-cycle preperiods; this quantitative counting argument uses the already known casewise transition map. Uniform random four-digit strings include leading zero digits and omit constant strings. Literature checking cannot exclude unindexed equivalent enumerations.
title: Exact entrance-time distribution for four-digit Kaprekar dynamics in odd bases
